verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is Grafana Cloud's Adaptive Telemetry, pitched as a way to 'simplify cost management' by aggregating low-value data and 'cutting your telemetry costs by up to 80%'. That is cost reduction, not spend visibility, attribution or spike detection. The LLM cost-tracking feature covers AI usage, not observability spend. General-purpose alerting exists, but nothing shows it applied to usage or billing data. missing for 10: a spend/usage dashboard, cost attribution by team or service, usage-spike or budget alerts on observability ingest, independent or hands-on corroboration.
